sentences.en: Many Palestinians don't have enough money to rebuild their houses.
sentences.zh: 许多巴勒斯坦人没有足够的钱重建他们的房子。

sentences.en: It'll take some time, but eventually we'll be able to rebuild.
sentences.zh: 这需要一些时间，但最终我们将能够重建。

sentences.en: We need to rebuild the population of the town.
sentences.zh: 我们需要恢复这个镇的人口。

senses.zh: 重建；改造，重新组装；复原 -

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re（重新）+build（建造）→重建
